text: {"tasks":[{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Query and quantify EU refund totals and counts by month for June and July 2026 to confirm the magnitude and existence of the increase."},{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Break down July 2026 EU refunds by country, product category, and refund reason to identify which segments drove the increase compared to June."},{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Analyze underlying order and return data (e.g., order volume, defect rates, shipping delays, policy or pricing changes) for June and July 2026 in the EU to identify potential root causes correlated with the refund spike."},{"role":"evaluator","objective":"Review the SQL analysts' findings to validate data accuracy, ensure the identified drivers statistically explain the refund increase, and confirm no conflicting evidence remains."},{"role":"orchestrator","objective":"Synthesize the validated findings into a coherent explanation of why EU refunds increased from June to July 2026 and summarize it for stakeholders."}]}
